reference.title: heated metal (Phase 2 spec, Wave 3): a steel bar banded from straw to blue by its temper colours, from the temper colour sources (study.md); builds from REFERENCE.md, with bar 10's pointer-as-light code and film-metal.html's steel film

alive.rests: The bar lies still on a still desk: nothing moves without the pointer. Film colour never moves with the clock (the iridescence law's (c)), and tempered steel holds its colours once cool

beats: A steel bar lies on a desk, heated at its top end: the oxide film is thickest there, and the temper bands run blue at the hot end, then purple, brown and straw toward the cold end, in that order
The bar's face is crowned across its width, so the key light's highlight is a stripe down its length that shows every band at once, and brushed grain along the bar streaks it

Moving the pointer moves the light: the key comes from a point above the pointer, so it turns off the eye and back; the highlight slides across the bar toward the light and the bands' hue shifts a little
No glow and no heat colour: tempering heat is far below a visible glow, so the colour is the thin film's alone
